# enumerates the guards from the repository (hook commands in .claude/settings.json,
# `# @guard fence:<id>` markers in block-destructive-bash.sh, `# @guard validator:<id>`

Replays are 29 # excluded and counted: replay == true (LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 at the source), or, 30 # for rows that predate the flag, a cwd under ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ or containing 31 # /bats-run-, /bats., /evals/results/ or /sandbox/, or a UTC minute holding 32 # BURST_ROWS (10) or more block rows (a suite replaying fixtures into the live 33 # log from inside the repository; no interactive session blocks ten commands in 34 # one minute). A block is a likely false 35 # positive (a heuristic) when its command holds a heredoc (`<<`; or, when 36 # .claude/scripts/lib/heredoc-classifier.sh defines heredoc_nonexec, a heredoc 37 # that function calls non-executing), when its cwd lies outside the repository 38 # (this checkout and its main worktree), or when its pattern id is a prose class 39 # (SP-1, FR-MERGE-2, FR-2-AMBIGUOUS) with no destructive verb at statement start. 40 # A real catch is a block that is not a likely false positive. 41 # 42 # Privacy: no command text, cwd, hostname, user or model name is written to any 43 # output;    522	      (if .hook == "block-destructive-bash" then
   523	         ["hook:safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"] + (if ((.pattern_id // "") | tostring | test("^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$")) then ["fence:" + .pattern_id] else [] end)
   524	       elif .hook == "implement-gate" then ["hook:compliance/implement-gate.sh", "gate:implement-gate"]
   525	       elif ((.hook // "") | type) == "string" and $hookid[.hook] != null then [$hookid[.hook]]
   526	       else [] end) as $ids
   527	      | {ids: ($ids | map(select(IN($known[])))),
   528	         block: (.action == "block" or .action == "deny"),
   529	         telemetry: (.action == "telemetry" or .action == "ask"),
   530	         fp: ((.action == "block" or .action == "deny") and likely_fp),
   531	         t: ._t})) as $cls
   532	  | ($cls | map(.ids[]) | unique) as $seen
   533	  | (["hook:safety/block-destructive-bash.sh", "hook:compliance/implement-gate.sh", "gate:implement-gate"]
   534	     + ($map.guards | map(select(.kind == "fence") | .id)) + $seen | unique) as $writers
   535	  | ($map.guards | map(. as $g
   536	      | if ($g.id | IN($writers[])) then
   537	          ($cls | map(select(any(.ids[]; . == $g.id)))) as $mine
   538	          | ($mine | map(select(.block and (.fp | not))) | map(.t) | max) as $last
   539	          | {id, kind, class, status, origin: origin_txt, knob, floor, registrations: (.registrations // []), audited: true,
   540	             blocks_30d: ($mine | map(select(.block)) | length),
   541	             likely_fp_30d: ($mine | map(select(.fp)) | length),
   542	             telemetry_30d: ($mine | map(select(.telemetry)) | length),
   543	             last_real_catch: (if $last == null then "none in window" else ($last | day) end)}
   544	        else
   545	          {id, kind, class, status, origin: origin_txt, knob, floor, registrations: (.registrations // []), audited: false,
   546	           blocks_30d: null, likely_fp_30d: null, telemetry_30d: null, last_real_catch: "n/a"}
   547	        end)) as $guards
   548	  | {
   549	      schema_version: 1,
   550	      generated_at: ($now | day),
   551	      window_days: $win,
   552	      scope: "host",
   553	      audit_segments: $segs,
   554	      audit_rows_read: $read,
   555	      audit_rows_unparseable: (($raw | length) - $read),
   556	      audit_rows_considered: ($inwin | length),
   557	      replay_rows_excluded: (($inwin | length) - ($live | length)),
   558	      replay_rows_by_rule: {
   559	        flag: ($inwin | map(select(.replay == true)) | length),
   560	        cwd: ($inwin | map(select(.replay != true and replay([]))) | length),
   561	        burst: ($inwin | map(select(.replay != true and (replay([]) | not) and replay($burst))) | length)
   562	      },
   563	      heuristic: "likely_fp = heredoc in the command OR cwd outside the repository OR (pattern SP-1, FR-MERGE-2 or FR-2-AMBIGUOUS with no destructive verb at statement start); real = block AND NOT likely_fp",
   564	      totals: {
   565	        guards: ($map.guards | length),
   566	        guards_without_origin: 0,
   567	        dormant: ($map.guards | map(select(.status == "dormant")) | length),
   568	        blocks_30d: ($cls | map(select(.block)) | length),
   569	        real_blocks_30d: ($cls | map(select(.block and (.fp | not))) | length),
   570	        likely_fp_30d: ($cls | map(select(.fp)) | length),
   571	        telemetry_30d: ($cls | map(select(.telemetry)) | length),
   572	        unattributed_30d: ($cls | map(select(.ids | length == 0)) | length)
   573	      },
   574	      guards: $guards
   575	    }
   576	' "$ROWS")" || die 3 "the audit log could not be joined"
   577	
   578	render_yield_md() {
   579	    jq -r "$JQ_DEFS"'
   580	      def n: if . == null then "n/a" else tostring end;
   581	      . as $y
   582	      | "# Guard yield (host)",
   583	        "",
   584	        "<!-- Generated by .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh; untracked, host-local. The structural register is grimoires/loa/guards.md. -->",
   585	        "",
   586	        "- generated_at: \($y.generated_at)",
   587	        "- window_days: \($y.window_days)",
   588	        "- scope: \($y.scope)",
   589	        "- audit_segments: \($y.audit_segments)",
   590	        "- audit_rows_considered: \($y.audit_rows_considered)",
   591	        "- replay_rows_excluded: \($y.replay_rows_excluded) (flag \($y.replay_rows_by_rule.flag), cwd \($y.replay_rows_by_rule.cwd), burst \($y.replay_rows_by_rule.burst))",
   592	        "- audit_rows_unparseable: \($y.audit_rows_unparseable)",
   593	        "- totals: \($y.totals.real_blocks_30d) real blocks, \($y.totals.likely_fp_30d) likely FP, \($y.totals.telemetry_30d) telemetry, \($y.totals.unattributed_30d) unattributed",
   594	        "- heuristic: \($y.heuristic | cell)",
   595	        (kinds[] as $k | ($y.guards | map(select(.kind == $k))) as $rows | select($rows | length > 0)
   596	          | "",
   597	            "## \($k) (\($rows | length))",
   598	            "",
   599	            "| id | class | status | origin | knob | floor | registrations | blocks_30d | likely_fp_30d | telemetry_30d | last_real_catch |",
   600	            "|----|-------|--------|--------|------|-------|---------------|------------|---------------|---------------|-----------------|",
   601	            ($rows[] | "| \(.id | cell) | \(.class | cell) | \(.status | cell) | \(.origin | cell) | \(.knob | cell) | \(.floor | yesno) | \(regs) | \(.blocks_30d | n) | \(.likely_fp_30d | n) | \(.telemetry_30d | n) | \(.last_real_catch | cell) |"))
   602	    ' <<<"$YIELD_JSON"
   603	}
   604	
   605	YIELD_MD_NEW="$TMPWORK/guard-yield.md"
   606	YIELD_JSON_NEW="$TMPWORK/guard-yield.json"
   607	render_yield_md > "$YIELD_MD_NEW"
   608	jq '.' <<<"$YIELD_JSON" > "$YIELD_JSON_NEW"
   609	
   610	install_file "$REGISTER_NEW" "$OUT"
   611	install_file "$YIELD_MD_NEW" "$YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.md"
   612	install_file "$YIELD_JSON_NEW" "$YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.json"
   613	if (( DO_HOOKS_TABLE )); then
   614	    render_hooks_ref "$HOOKS_BLOCK" "$HOOKS_REF_NEW"
   615	    cmp -s "$HOOKS_REF_NEW" "$HOOKS_REF" || install_file "$HOOKS_REF_NEW" "$HOOKS_REF"
   616	fi
   617	
   618	summary="$(jq -r '"\(.totals.guards) guards (\(.totals.dormant) dormant); \(.window_days) d: \(.totals.real_blocks_30d) real blocks, \(.totals.likely_fp_30d) likely FP, \(.replay_rows_excluded) replay rows excluded; scope host"' <<<"$YIELD_JSON")"
   619	if (( DO_JSON )); then
   620	    cat "$YIELD_JSON_NEW"
   621	    echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: wrote $OUT and $YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.{md,json}: $summary" >&2
   622	else
   623	    echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: wrote $OUT and $YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.{md,json}: $summary"
   624	fi
   625	exit 0

 **Jack in**: To start an autonomous run under run mode; a run that has finished or been stopped for good has jacked out.
 _Aliases_: jack out
 
+**Judgment**: The task kind for work that needs reading and a decision; it ships as prose or a reviewed artifact, and its sprint task line ends with kind: judgment.
+
 **Kaironic**: Stopping at the right moment rather than after a fixed count: an iterative review loop ends when successive passes stop finding material issues.
 _Avoid_: converged
 
 **Karpathy principles**: The four working rules applied on every code-touching turn: think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes and goal-driven verification.
 
+**Kind counts**: The release-notes line that counts a cycle's sprint tasks by kind (mechanical, judgment and operator), read from the tagged task lines of its sprint plan.
+
 **Known failure**: A recorded degradation with its symptom, the attempts made and a reading guide, consulted before triage so that prior dead ends are not retried.
 _Aliases_: KF
 
@@ -62,6 +66,10 @@ ## Language
 
 **Map epic**: The epic bead that parents an effort's decision tickets, paired with a map document of its destination, decisions so far, fog and exclusions; run mode never implements it.
 
+**Mechanical**: The task kind for work a script could do reliably; it ships as code with tests, and a review flags a mechanical task delivered as prose the model re-executes.
+
+**Operator**: The human who owns the project and its decisions; as a task kind, work that belongs to that human, which a review flags when it was completed unattended without a decision:unblock ticket or a DEC row.
+
 **Round**: One frontier of interview questions asked together and answered together.
 
 **Run mode**: Unattended execution of a sprint plan with a circuit breaker, wrapping implement, review and audit in a loop. Its states are running, halted and jacked out.
@@ -78,4 +86,6 @@ ## Language
 
 **Voice**: The party a decision or finding is attributed to: the operator, the agent, Flatline or dissent.
 
+**Volume ratio**: The release-notes line that sets a cycle's script lines changed against its prose bytes changed and its model calls; the model-call count is local to the host that ran the cycle.

@@ -123,9 +149,140 @@ if [[ -d "$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/rules" ]]; then

+ARM_MODE=false

+  if [[ -z "$suite_file" ]]; then
+    local tdir; tdir="$(basename "$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")")"
+    [[ -f "$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/$tdir.yaml" ]] && suite_file="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/$tdir.yaml"

+    found="$(ARM="$ARM" yq '[.ab.arms[]? | select(.id == strenv(ARM))] | length' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"

+  tmp="$(mktemp "$eval_dir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
+  awk -v h="$heading" '
+    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }

+    skip { n++; next }

+  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"

+# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
+# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
+# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
+_drop_paragraph() {
+  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
+import re, sys
+path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
+paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
+for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
+    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
+        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
+            removed = paras[i]
+            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
+            del paras[i:i + 2]
+            open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(paras))
+            open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(removed + "\n")
+            sys.exit(0)

+}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# run-arms.sh — cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm driver (SDD D-2.3, DEC-0164, DEC-0171)
     4	#
     5	# Runs the declared control arms of one recall suite on a frozen fixture batch
     6	# against a detached git worktree pinned at --source-commit (never the live
     7	# tree), interleaving trials across arms so provider drift spreads evenly.
     8	#
     9	# Usage:
    10	#   run-arms.sh --suite review-recall|audit-recall --arms a,b,c
    11	#               --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,… --trials 3 --source-commit <sha>
    12	#               [--model <id>] [--concurrency 2] [--batch <name>]
    13	#               [--results-dir evals/results/arms] [--retry-wait <s>]
    14	#               [--allow-unapproved] [--dry-run]
    15	#
    16	# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
    17	#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
    18	#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
    19	#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
    20	#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
    21	#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
    22	#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
    23	#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
    24	#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
    25	#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
    26	#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
    27	#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
    28	#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
    29	#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
    30	#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
    31	#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
    32	#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.
    33	#
    34	# Layout: <results-dir>/<suite>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json,STATUS.json,run.log,
    35	#   <arm>/results.jsonl,<arm>/artifacts/…}; <results-dir>/<suite>/STATUS.json
    36	#   aggregates every batch of the suite (the Sprint 2 gate and report.sh
    37	#   --arms read it). STATUS.json: {state: running|complete|partial|failed,
    38	#   per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_done, trials_failed, trials_planned}},
    39	#   source_commit, model_id, started, finished}.
    40	#
    41	# Exit: 0 complete, 1 partial (some trial failed twice; results kept),
    42	#       2 usage / refused before starting, 3 failed (no trial completed, or
    43	#       the corpus drifted mid-run)
    44	#
    45	# Executor: Fable 5.1 (D33, DEC-0164); the default --model is the id the
    46	# local claude CLI accepted on the cycle-129 probe (claude-fable-5-1).
    47	# Tested by evals/tests/run-arms.bats (stubbed CLI; no model call).
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    53	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    54	EVALS_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/evals"
    55	CORPUS_DIR="$EVALS_DIR/fixtures/review-prs"
    56	DEFAULT_MODEL="claude-fable-5-1"
    57	CACHE_ROOT="${LOA_ARMS_CACHE:-$HOME/.cache/loa/cycle-129}"
    58	# the repository the pinned source worktree is cut from (tests point it at a
    59	# throwaway repo so they never register a worktree in the real one)
    60	SOURCE_REPO="${LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO:-$REPO_ROOT}"
    61	
    62	SUITE="" ARMS_CSV="" FIXTURES_CSV="" TRIALS="" SOURCE_COMMIT="" MODEL="$DEFAULT_MODEL"
    63	CONCURRENCY=2 BATCH="" RESULTS_ROOT="$EVALS_DIR/results/arms" RETRY_WAIT=300
    64	DRY_RUN=false ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=false
    65	
    66	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,46p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    67	die() { echo "run-arms: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    68	
    69	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    70	  case "$1" in
    71	    --suite) SUITE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arms) ARMS_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --fixtures) FIXTURES_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    74	    --trials) TRIALS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    75	    --source-commit) SOURCE_COMMIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    76	    --model) MODEL="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    77	    --concurrency) CONCURRENCY="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    78	    --batch) BATCH="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    79	    --results-dir) RESULTS_ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    80	    --retry-wait) RETRY_WAIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    81	    --allow-unapproved) ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=true; shift ;;
    82	    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=true; shift ;;
    83	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    84	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    85	  esac
    86	done
    87	
    88	# --- validate arguments ------------------------------------------------------
    89	case "$SUITE" in review-recall|audit-recall) ;; *) die "--suite must be review-recall or audit-recall" ;; esac
    90	[[ "$TRIALS" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]?$ ]] || die "--trials must be an integer 1-99"
    91	[[ "$CONCURRENCY" =~ ^[1-9]$ ]] || die "--concurrency must be 1-9"
    92	[[ "$RETRY_WAIT" =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] || die "--retry-wait must be whole seconds"
    93	[[ "$MODEL" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]+$ ]] || die "--model has unexpected characters"
    94	[[ "$SOURCE_COMMIT" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ ]] || die "--source-commit must be a hex commit id"
    95	for tool in git jq yq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
    96	
    97	SUITE_FILE="$EVALS_DIR/suites/$SUITE.yaml"
    98	[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
    99	TASK_PREFIX="review"; [[ "$SUITE" == "audit-recall" ]] && TASK_PREFIX="audit"
   100	
   101	IFS=',' read -r -a ARMS <<<"$ARMS_CSV"
   102	IFS=',' read -r -a FIXTURES <<<"$FIXTURES_CSV"
   103	[[ ${#ARMS[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${ARMS[0]}" ]] || die "--arms is required"
   104	[[ ${#FIXTURES[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${FIXTURES[0]}" ]] || die "--fixtures is required"
   105	for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do
   106	  [[ "$a" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || die "invalid arm id '$a'"
   107	  [[ "$(A="$a" yq '[.ab.arms[]? | select(.id == strenv(A))] | length' "$SUITE_FILE")" -gt 0 ]] \
   108	    || die "arm '$a' is not declared in $SUITE_FILE (ab.arms[])"
   109	done
   110	for f in "${FIXTURES[@]}"; do
   111	  [[ "$f" =~ ^pr-[0-9]{2}$ ]] || die "invalid fixture id '$f' (want pr-NN)"
   112	  [[ -d "$CORPUS_DIR/$f" ]] || die "fixture not found: $CORPUS_DIR/$f"
   113	  [[ -f "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json" ]] || die "hidden manifest not found for $f"
   114	  [[ -f "$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml" ]] || die "task not found: tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml"
   115	  if [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("approved") then .approved else true end' "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json")" != "true" \
   116	        && "$ALLOW_UNAPPROVED" != "true" ]]; then
   117	    die "$f: labels.tsv is not approved yet (seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve $f --by '<who> <date>'), or pass --allow-unapproved"
   118	  fi
   119	done
   120	
   121	SRC_FULL="$(git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${SOURCE_COMMIT}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null)" \
   122	  || die "source commit $SOURCE_COMMIT is not in this repository"
   123	SRC12="${SRC_FULL:0:12}"
   124	WORKTREE="$CACHE_ROOT/arms-src-$SRC12"
   125	
   126	[[ -n "$BATCH" ]] || BATCH="batch-${FIXTURES[0]}-${FIXTURES[${#FIXTURES[@]}-1]}-n${#FIXTURES[@]}"
   127	[[ "$BATCH" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,80}$ ]] || die "invalid --batch '$BATCH'"
   128	SUITE_DIR="$RESULTS_ROOT/$SUITE"
   129	BATCH_DIR="$SUITE_DIR/$BATCH"
   130	
   131	# --- corpus freeze ------------------------------------------------------------
   132	# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries
   133	# and its manifest) hashes as recorded. Prints the SHA256SUMS digest.
   134	verify_corpus() {
   135	  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'
   136	import hashlib, os, sys
   137	corpus, only = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   138	sums = os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS")
   139	raw = open(sums, "rb").read()
   140	bad = []
   141	for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
   142	    if not line.strip():
   143	        continue
   144	    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
   145	    if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/") or rel == f"manifests/{only}.json" or rel == "corpus.tsv"
   146	                     or rel.startswith(f"labels/{only}.")):
   147	        continue
   148	    p = os.path.join(corpus, rel)
   149	    if not os.path.isfile(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != digest:
   150	        bad.append(rel)
   151	if bad:
   152	    print("corpus drift: " + ", ".join(bad[:10]), file=sys.stderr)
   153	    sys.exit(1)
   154	print(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
   155	PY
   156	}
   157	CORPUS_DIGEST="$(verify_corpus)" || die "fixture corpus does not match SHA256SUMS (run build/seed with --check first)"
   158	
   159	# --- the planned trials (interleaved: trial-major, then fixture, then arm) ----
   160	PLAN=()
   161	for t in $(seq 1 "$TRIALS"); do
   162	  for f in "${FIXTURES[@]}"; do
   163	    for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do PLAN+=("$a|$f|$t"); done
   164	  done
   165	done
   166	
   167	json_array() { printf '%s\n' "$@" | jq -R . | jq -sc .; }
   168	
   169	write_manifest() {  # write_manifest <path> <dry_run>
   170	  local out="$1" dry="$2" claude_bin="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}" cli_version
   171	  cli_version="$("$claude_bin" --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo unknown)"
   172	  local harness_commit harness_dirty=false
   173	  harness_commit="$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
   174	  [[ -n "$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" status --porcelain -- evals/harness evals/graders evals/suites evals/tasks 2>/dev/null)" ]] && harness_dirty=true
   175	  local per_trial
   176	  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-${FIXTURES[0]}.yaml")"
   177	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
   178	  jq -n \
   179	    --arg suite "$SUITE" --arg batch "$BATCH" \
   180	    --arg source_commit "$SRC_FULL" --arg source_worktree "$WORKTREE" \
   181	    --arg harness_commit "$harness_commit" --argjson harness_dirty "$harness_dirty" \
   182	    --arg model_id "$MODEL" --arg cli "$claude_bin" --arg cli_version "$cli_version" \
   183	    --argjson trials "$TRIALS" --argjson concurrency "$CONCURRENCY" --argjson retry_wait "$RETRY_WAIT" \
   184	    --argjson per_trial "$per_trial" --arg max_turns "${EVAL_MAX_TURNS:-40}" \
   185	    --argjson arms "$(json_array "${ARMS[@]}")" --argjson fixtures "$(json_array "${FIXTURES[@]}")" \
   186	    --argjson planned "${#PLAN[@]}" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" \
   187	    --arg os "$(uname -srm)" --arg bash_v "$BASH_VERSION" \
   188	    --arg jq_v "$(jq --version 2>/dev/null)" --arg yq_v "$(yq --version 2>/dev/null)" \
   189	    --arg py_v "$(python3 --version 2>/dev/null)" --arg git_v "$(git --version 2>/dev/null)" \
   190	    --arg created "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --argjson dry "$dry" \
   191	    --arg suite_file "evals/suites/$SUITE.yaml" \
   192	    '{schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, batch: $batch, dry_run: $dry, created: $created,
   193	      source_commit: $source_commit, source_worktree: $source_worktree,
   194	      harness_commit: $harness_commit, harness_dirty: $harness_dirty, suite_file: $suite_file,
   195	      model_id: $model_id,
   196	      executor: {cli: $cli, cli_version: $cli_version, tools: "Read,Grep,Glob,Write", restricted: true,
   197	                 permission_mode: "acceptEdits", max_turns: ($max_turns | tonumber), effort: "task/skill default",
   198	                 timeout_per_trial_s: $per_trial, concurrency: $concurrency, retry: {transport_retries: 1, wait_s: $retry_wait},
   199	                 subagent_model: "pinned to model_id (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL); parent-session coupling unset",
   200	                 seed: null},
   201	      arms: $arms, fixtures: $fixtures, trials: $trials, trials_planned: $planned,
   202	      corpus: {manifest: "evals/fixtures/review-prs/SHA256SUMS", sha256: $digest,
   203	               verified: "every entry before the batch; the fixture'"'"'s entries before each trial"},
   204	      environment: {os: $os, bash: $bash_v, jq: $jq_v, yq: $yq_v, python: $py_v, git: $git_v}}' > "$out.tmp"

   206	}

   208	if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == "true" ]]; then
   209	  mpath="$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json"

   212	  echo "run-arms (dry run): suite=$SUITE batch=$BATCH source=$SRC12 model=$MODEL worktree=$WORKTREE"
   213	  echo "planned trials: ${#PLAN[@]} (${#FIXTURES[@]} fixtures x ${#ARMS[@]} arms x $TRIALS trials, concurrency $CONCURRENCY)"
   214	  i=0
   215	  for p in "${PLAN[@]}"; do
   216	    i=$((i + 1)); IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"
   217	    printf '%4d  %-16s %-6s trial %s  task %s-%s\n' "$i" "$a" "$f" "$t" "$TASK_PREFIX" "$f"
   218	  done
   219	  echo "manifest: $mpath"
   220	  exit 0
   221	fi
   222	
   223	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
   224	command -v "$CLAUDE_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ -x "$CLAUDE_BIN" ]] || die "executor CLI not found: $CLAUDE_BIN"
   225	
   226	# --- the pinned source worktree -------------------------------------------------
   227	mkdir -p "$CACHE_ROOT"

   262	STATE="running"

   282	
   283	# The suite-level STATUS.json merges every batch: counters add per arm; the
   284	# state is failed > running > partial > complete; source/model must agree.
   285	aggregate_status() {
   286	  local agg="$SUITE_DIR/STATUS.json" lockd="$SUITE_DIR/.status.lock" n=0
   287	  until mkdir "$lockd" 2>/dev/null; do n=$((n + 1)); [[ $n -gt 50 ]] && return 0; sleep 0.1; done
   288	  # shellcheck disable=SC2046

   290	    def rank: {"failed": 4, "running": 3, "partial": 2, "complete": 1}[.] // 4;
   291	    (map(.state) | max_by(rank)) as $state |
   292	    {schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, state: $state,
   293	     batches: map({batch, state, started, finished}),
   294	     per_arm: (reduce (.[] | .per_arm | to_entries[]) as $e ({};
   295	        .[$e.key] |= {trials_done: ((.trials_done // 0) + $e.value.trials_done),
   296	                      trials_failed: ((.trials_failed // 0) + $e.value.trials_failed),
   297	                      trials_planned: ((.trials_planned // 0) + $e.value.trials_planned)})),
   298	     source_commit: (map(.source_commit) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
   299	     model_id: (map(.model_id) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
   300	     started: (map(.started) | min), finished: (if $state == "running" then null else (map(.finished) | max) end)}' \
   301	    $(find "$SUITE_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name STATUS.json | sort) > "$agg.tmp" 2>/dev/null \

   307	# --- one trial (runs in a background job; writes its row to $JOBS_DIR/<id>.row)
   308	is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
   309	  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
   310	  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"

   319	run_trial() {  # run_trial <job-id> <arm> <fixture> <trial>

   325	  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$task")"
   326	  start_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"

   328	    printf 'DRIFT\n' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag"; return 0
   329	  fi
   330	  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
   331	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
   332	    trial_id="$run_id-$arm-$fx-t$trial-a$attempt-$jid"
   333	    ws="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" create --fixture "review-prs/$fx" --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" 2>/dev/null)" \
   334	      || { err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"sandbox creation failed"}'; break; }
   335	    ex_rc=0
   336	    EVAL_PROMPT_TREE="$WORKTREE" EVAL_MODEL="$MODEL" LOA_EVAL_ARM="$arm" LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE="$SUITE_FILE" \
   337	      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT="$SRC_FULL" LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 \
   338	      "$SCRIPT_DIR/execute-agent.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
   339	        --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" --timeout "$per_trial" \
   340	        >/dev/null 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log" || ex_rc=$?
   341	    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/executor.json" ]] && executor="$(cat "$ws/.eval/executor.json")"
   342	    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 0 ]]; then
   343	      local gout gexit=0
   344	      gout="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/grade.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
   345	        --timeout "$(yq -r '.timeout.per_grader // 60' "$task")" 2>/dev/null)" || gexit=$?

   350	      else err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"grader error"}'; fi
   351	      break

   355	      if [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; then

   358	        ws=""; executor='null'

   361	    else

   363	    fi
   364	    break
   365	  done

   369	    "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

   373	    --arg status "$status" --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg run_date "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" \

   379	      duration_ms: $duration_ms, source_commit: $src, model_requested: $model_req,
   380	      model_id: ($executor.model_id? // null), model_version: ($executor.model_id? // "none"), seed: null,
   381	      corpus_sha256: $digest, corpus_sha256_at_trial: $digest_now, fixture_verified: true, graders: $graders, composite: $composite, error: $error}

   384	}

   386	keep_artifacts() {  # keep_artifacts <ws> <arm> <task_id> <trial> <suffix>

   398	# Parent-side: append a finished job's row and update the counters.
   399	collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>
   400	  local jid="$1" arm="$2" i
   401	  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
   402	  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then

   411	      log "done $jid ($(jq -r '"\(.arm) \(.fixture) t\(.trial) recall=\(([.graders[]? | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall][0]) // "n/a") \(.duration_ms/1000|floor)s"' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
   412	    else

   415	    fi

   427	
   428	PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
   429	reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
   430	  local i
   431	  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
   432	    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
   433	      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
   434	        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
   435	        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PARM[$i]}"
   436	        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PARM[i]'
   437	        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PARM=("${PARM[@]+"${PARM[@]}"}")
   438	        break
   439	      fi
   440	    done
   441	    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep 1
   442	  done
   443	  return 0
   444	}
   445	
   446	n=0
   447	for p in "${PLAN[@]}"; do
   448	  IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"

   450	  reap "$CONCURRENCY"
   451	  run_trial "$jid" "$a" "$f" "$t" &
   452	  PIDS+=("$!"); PJOB+=("$jid"); PARM+=("$a")
   453	done

   456	total_done=0 total_failed=0

   458	if [[ $total_failed -eq 0 ]]; then

   460	elif [[ $total_done -eq 0 ]]; then
   461	  set_state failed; log "failed: no trial completed ($total_failed failed)"; exit 3
   462	else
   463	  set_state partial; log "partial: $total_done done, $total_failed failed"; exit 1
   464	fi

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# run-arms.sh — cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm driver (SDD D-2.3, DEC-0164, DEC-0171)
     4	#
     5	# Runs the declared control arms of one recall suite on a frozen fixture batch
     6	# against a detached git worktree pinned at --source-commit (never the live
     7	# tree), interleaving trials across arms so provider drift spreads evenly.
     8	#
     9	# Usage:
    10	#   run-arms.sh --suite review-recall|audit-recall --arms a,b,c
    11	#               --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,… --trials 3 --source-commit <sha>
    12	#               [--model <id>] [--concurrency 2] [--batch <name>]
    13	#               [--results-dir evals/results/arms] [--retry-wait <s>]
    14	#               [--allow-unapproved] [--dry-run]
    15	#
    16	# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
    17	#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
    18	#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
    19	#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
    20	#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
    21	#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
    22	#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
    23	#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
    24	#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
    25	#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
    26	#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
    27	#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
    28	#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
    29	#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
    30	#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
    31	#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
    32	#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.
    33	#
    34	# Layout: <results-dir>/<suite>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json,STATUS.json,run.log,
    35	#   <arm>/results.jsonl,<arm>/artifacts/…}; <results-dir>/<suite>/STATUS.json
    36	#   aggregates every batch of the suite (the Sprint 2 gate and report.sh

    38	#   per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_done, trials_failed, trials_planned}},
    39	#   source_commit, model_id, started, finished}.

    41	# Exit: 0 complete, 1 partial (some trial failed twice; results kept),
    42	#       2 usage / refused before starting, 3 failed (no trial completed, or
    43	#       the corpus drifted mid-run)
    44	#
    45	# Executor: Fable 5.1 (D33, DEC-0164); the default --model is the id the

    47	# Tested by evals/tests/run-arms.bats (stubbed CLI; no model call).

   132	# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries
   133	# and its manifest) hashes as recorded. Prints the SHA256SUMS digest.
   134	verify_corpus() {
   135	  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'
   136	import hashlib, os, sys
   137	corpus, only = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   138	sums = os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS")
   139	raw = open(sums, "rb").read()
   140	bad = []
   141	for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
   142	    if not line.strip():
   143	        continue
   144	    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
   145	    if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/") or rel == f"manifests/{only}.json" or rel == "corpus.tsv"
   146	                     or rel.startswith(f"labels/{only}.")):
   147	        continue
   148	    p = os.path.join(corpus, rel)
   149	    if not os.path.isfile(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != digest:
   150	        bad.append(rel)
   151	if bad:
   152	    print("corpus drift: " + ", ".join(bad[:10]), file=sys.stderr)
   153	    sys.exit(1)
   154	print(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
   155	PY
   156	}

   448	  IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"
   449	  n=$((n + 1)); jid="$(printf 'j%04d' "$n")"
   450	  reap "$CONCURRENCY"

   454	reap 1

   457	for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do total_done=$(( total_done + ${DONE[$i]} )); total_failed=$(( total_failed + ${FAILED[$i]} )); done

    95	def bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, seed):
    96	    """Percentile bootstrap of the mean of per-fixture deltas (resample fixtures)."""
    97	    if not deltas:

   106	class Arm:
   107	    def __init__(self, arm_id):

   346	def main():
   347	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
   348	    ap.add_argument("--results-root", required=True)
   349	    ap.add_argument("--suites-dir", required=True)
   350	    ap.add_argument("--suites", default="")

   354	    args = ap.parse_args()

    33	import argparse
    34	import datetime
    35	import json
    36	import os
    37	import random
    38	import sys
    39	from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    40	
    41	
    42	def load_yaml_subset(path):
    43	    """The suites are YAML (no stdlib parser); the harness already depends on yq v4."""
    44	    import subprocess
    45	    out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    46	    return json.loads(out)
    47

    49	def read_jsonl(path):
    50	    rows = []
    51	    if not os.path.isfile(path):
    52	        return rows
    53	    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    54	        for line in fh:
    55	            line = line.strip()
    56	            if line:
    57	                try:
    58	                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
    59	                except ValueError:
    60	                    continue
    61	    return rows
    62	
    63	
    64	def mean(xs):
    65	    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    66	    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
    67	
    68	
    69	def fmt(x, nd=3):
    70	    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.{nd}f}"
    71	
    72	
    73	def recall_details(row):
    74	    for g in row.get("graders") or []:
    75	        if g.get("name") == "recall-vs-defects.sh" and isinstance(g.get("details"), dict):
    76	            return g["details"]
    77	    return None
    78	
    79	
    80	def tokens(row):
    81	    u = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("usage") or {}
    82	    if not u:
    83	        return None
    84	    return sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
    85	               ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
    86	
    87	
    88	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
    89	    if not sorted_xs:
    90	        return None
    91	    k = max(0, min(len(sorted_xs) - 1, int(round(q * (len(sorted_xs) - 1)))))
    92	    return sorted_xs[k]
    93	
    94	
    95	def bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, seed):
    96	    """Percentile bootstrap of the mean of per-fixture deltas (resample fixtures)."""
    97	    if not deltas:
    98	        return None, None
    99	    rng = random.Random(seed)
   100	    n = len(deltas)
   101	    means = sorted(sum(deltas[rng.randrange(n)] for _ in range(n)) / n for _ in range(iterations))
   102	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
   103	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
   104	
   105	
   106	class Arm:
   107	    def __init__(self, arm_id):
   108	        self.id = arm_id
   109	        self.cells = defaultdict(list)   # fixture -> [(trial, recall)], every completed trial kept
   110	        self.planted = {}                # fixture -> planted count
   111	        self.cited = 0
   112	        self.refuted = 0
   113	        self.tokens = []
   114	        self.models = set()
   115	        self.sources = set()
   116	        self.done = 0
   117	        self.errors = 0
   118	        self.fallback_trials = 0         # trials the CLI moved to another model on a safeguard refusal
   119	        self.fallback_kinds = Counter()
   120	        self.missed = Counter()          # (fixture, label) -> trials missed
   121	        self.seen = Counter()            # (fixture, label) -> trials graded
   122	
   123	    def add(self, row):
   124	        if row.get("status") != "completed":
   125	            self.errors += 1
   126	            return
   127	        d = recall_details(row)
   128	        if d is None:
   129	            self.errors += 1
   130	            return
   131	        self.done += 1
   132	        fx = row.get("fixture") or row.get("task_id", "").split("-", 1)[-1]
   133	        self.planted[fx] = int(d.get("planted") or 0)
   134	        if d.get("recall") is not None:
   135	            self.cells[fx].append((int(row.get("trial") or 0), float(d["recall"])))
   136	        if d.get("findings_cited") is not None:
   137	            self.cited += int(d.get("findings_cited") or 0)
   138	            self.refuted += int(d.get("findings_refuted") or 0)
   139	        t = tokens(row)
   140	        if t is not None:
   141	            self.tokens.append(t)
   142	        self.models.add(row.get("model_id") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("model_id"))
   143	        # every model that produced output in the call (an auxiliary model is skew too)
   144	        for mid, out in ((row.get("executor") or {}).get("models_used") or {}).items():
   145	            if out:
   146	                self.models.add(mid)
   147	        fb = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("refusal_fallbacks") or []
   148	        if fb:
   149	            self.fallback_trials += 1
   150	            for x in fb:
   151	                self.fallback_kinds[f"{x.get('from')}→{x.get('to')} ({x.get('category')})"] += 1
   152	        self.sources.add(row.get("source_commit") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("source_commit"))
   153	        for lbl in d.get("missed") or []:
   154	            self.missed[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   155	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   156	        for lbl in d.get("detected") or []:
   157	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   158	
   159	    def defect_fixtures(self):
   160	        return sorted(f for f, p in self.planted.items() if p > 0 and self.cells.get(f))
   161	
   162	    def fixture_means(self):
   163	        return {f: mean([r for _t, r in self.cells[f]]) for f in self.defect_fixtures()}
   164	
   165	    def trial_means(self):
   166	        by_trial = defaultdict(list)
   167	        for f in self.defect_fixtures():
   168	            for t, r in self.cells[f]:
   169	                by_trial[t].append(r)
   170	        return {t: mean(v) for t, v in sorted(by_trial.items())}
   171	
   172	    def refuted_share(self):
   173	        return self.refuted / self.cited if self.cited else None
   174	
   175	
   176	def suite_report(root, suites_dir, suite, partial, out_lines):
   177	    sdir = os.path.join(root, suite)
   178	    status = {}
   179	    sp = os.path.join(sdir, "STATUS.json")
   180	    if os.path.isfile(sp):
   181	        status = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
   182	    spec = load_yaml_subset(os.path.join(suites_dir, f"{suite}.yaml"))
   183	    ab = spec.get("ab") or {}
   184	    th = ab.get("threshold") or {}
   185	    arm_meta = {a["id"]: a for a in ab.get("arms") or []}
   186	    trials_required = int(th.get("trials_required", 3))
   187	    max_drop = float(th.get("mean_recall_max_drop", 0.10))
   188	    min_trial_drop = float(th.get("min_trial_recall_max_drop", 0.15))
   189	    refuted_rise = float(th.get("refuted_share_max_rise", 0.10))
   190	    bs = th.get("bootstrap") or {}
   191	    iterations = int(bs.get("iterations", 2000))
   192	    level = float(bs.get("level", 0.90))
   193	
   194	    planned_fx, planned_arms, manifests = set(), [], []
   195	    arms = {}
   196	    for batch in sorted(os.listdir(sdir)) if os.path.isdir(sdir) else []:
   197	        bdir = os.path.join(sdir, batch)
   198	        mp = os.path.join(bdir, "MANIFEST.json")
   199	        if not os.path.isfile(mp):
   200	            continue
   201	        m = json.load(open(mp, encoding="utf-8"))
   202	        if m.get("dry_run"):
   203	            continue
   204	        manifests.append(m)
   205	        planned_fx.update(m.get("fixtures") or [])
   206	        for a in m.get("arms") or []:
   207	            if a not in planned_arms:
   208	                planned_arms.append(a)
   209	            arm = arms.setdefault(a, Arm(a))
   210	            for row in read_jsonl(os.path.join(bdir, a, "results.jsonl")):
   211	                arm.add(row)
   212	    order = [a for a in arm_meta if a in arms] + [a for a in planned_arms if a not in arm_meta]
   213	    state = status.get("state", "unknown")
   214	    complete = state == "complete"
   215	
   216	    out_lines.append(f"## {suite}")
   217	    out_lines.append("")
   218	    out_lines.append(f"- STATUS: `{state}`; batches: {', '.join(b.get('batch', '?') for b in status.get('batches', [])) or 'none'}")
   219	    srcs = sorted({m.get('source_commit') for m in manifests})
   220	    models = sorted({m.get('model_id') for m in manifests})
   221	    out_lines.append(f"- source commit(s): {', '.join(f'`{s[:12]}`' for s in srcs if s) or 'n/a'}; executor model requested: {', '.join(f'`{x}`' for x in models if x) or 'n/a'}")
   222	    out_lines.append(f"- planned fixtures ({len(planned_fx)}): {', '.join(sorted(planned_fx)) or 'none'}")
   223	    out_lines.append(f"- threshold: trials_required {trials_required}, mean_recall_max_drop {max_drop}, "
   224	                     f"min_trial_recall_max_drop {min_trial_drop}, refuted_share_max_rise {refuted_rise}, "
   225	                     f"bootstrap {bs.get('method', 'percentile')} {level} over {bs.get('resample', 'fixtures')} x{iterations}")
   226	    out_lines.append("")
   227	
   228	    base = arms.get("baseline")
   229	    base_fm = base.fixture_means() if base else {}
   230	    base_tm = base.trial_means() if base else {}
   231	    base_spread = (max(base_tm.values()) - min(base_tm.values())) if base_tm else None
   232	    base_min = min(base_tm.values()) if base_tm else None
   233	    base_ref = base.refuted_share() if base else None
   234	
   235	    def coverage_gaps(arm):
   236	        gaps = []
   237	        for fx in sorted(planned_fx):
   238	            planted = arm.planted.get(fx)
   239	            n = len(arm.cells.get(fx, [])) if planted else 0
   240	            if planted == 0:
   241	                continue  # a clean fixture carries no recall; refuted share only
   242	            if n < trials_required:
   243	                gaps.append(f"{fx} {n}/{trials_required}")
   244	        return gaps
   245	
   246	    header = ("| arm | trials done | errors | mean recall | min | max | spread | drop vs baseline | "
   247	              f"{int(level * 100)}% CI of drop | refuted share | tokens/call | verdict |")
   248	    out_lines.append(header)
   249	    out_lines.append("|" + "---|" * 12)
   250	    details = []
   251	    verdicts = {}
   252	    for a in order:
   253	        arm = arms[a]
   254	        fm = arm.fixture_means()
   255	        tm = arm.trial_means()
   256	        m = mean(list(fm.values()))
   257	        mn = min(tm.values()) if tm else None
   258	        mx = max(tm.values()) if tm else None
   259	        spread = (mx - mn) if tm else None
   260	        rs = arm.refuted_share()
   261	        tok = mean(arm.tokens)
   262	        drop = lo = hi = None
   263	        reasons = []
   264	        if a == "baseline":
   265	            verdict = "(reference)"
   266	        else:
   267	            common = sorted(set(fm) & set(base_fm))
   268	            deltas = [base_fm[f] - fm[f] for f in common]
   269	            drop = mean(deltas)
   270	            lo, hi = bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, f"{suite}:{a}")
   271	            if partial:
   272	                reasons.append("--partial report")
   273	            if not complete:
   274	                reasons.append(f"run state is {state}")
   275	            if base is None:
   276	                reasons.append("no baseline arm")
   277	            gaps = coverage_gaps(arm) + ([f"baseline {g}" for g in coverage_gaps(base)] if base else [])
   278	            if gaps:
   279	                reasons.append("coverage: " + ", ".join(gaps[:8]) + (" …" if len(gaps) > 8 else ""))
   280	            mods = {x for x in arm.models | (base.models if base else set()) if x}
   281	            if len(mods) > 1:
   282	                reasons.append("model skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(mods)))
   283	            srcs_a = {x for x in arm.sources | (base.sources if base else set()) if x}
   284	            if len(srcs_a) > 1:
   285	                reasons.append("source skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(s[:12] for s in srcs_a)))
   286	            if not deltas:
   287	                reasons.append("no defect fixture graded in both arms")
   288	            if reasons:
   289	                verdict = "inconclusive"
   290	            else:
   291	                violated, refuted_violated = [], False
   292	                if hi is None or hi > max_drop:
   293	                    violated.append(f"drop CI upper {fmt(hi)} > {max_drop}")
   294	                if mn is None or base_min is None or mn < base_min - min_trial_drop:
   295	                    violated.append(f"min trial {fmt(mn)} < baseline min {fmt(base_min)} - {min_trial_drop}")
   296	                if rs is not None and base_ref is not None and rs > base_ref + refuted_rise:
   297	                    violated.append(f"refuted share {fmt(rs)} > baseline {fmt(base_ref)} + {refuted_rise}")
   298	                    refuted_violated = True
   299	                if not violated:
   300	                    verdict = "no recall loss"
   301	                elif (not refuted_violated and drop is not None and base_spread is not None
   302	                      and abs(drop) <= base_spread):
   303	                    # only recall rules failed and the mean moved less than the
   304	                    # baseline moves against itself: too small a change to name
   305	                    verdict = "inconclusive"
   306	                    reasons.append("rule violated (" + "; ".join(violated) + f") but |drop| {fmt(abs(drop))} "
   307	                                   f"<= baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: no change can be named")
   308	                else:
   309	                    verdict = "recall loss"
   310	                    reasons.extend(violated)
   311	            if (arm_meta.get(a) or {}).get("informational"):
   312	                verdict += " (informational: yield only)"
   313	        verdicts[a] = verdict
   314	        out_lines.append(
   315	            f"| `{a}` | {arm.done} | {arm.errors} | {fmt(m)} | {fmt(mn)} | {fmt(mx)} | {fmt(spread)} | "
   316	            f"{fmt(drop)} | {('[' + fmt(lo) + ', ' + fmt(hi) + ']') if lo is not None else 'n/a'} | "
   317	            f"{fmt(rs)} | {('%.0f' % tok) if tok is not None else 'n/a'} | **{verdict}** |")
   318	        if arm.fallback_trials:
   319	            reasons.append(f"{arm.fallback_trials}/{arm.done} trial(s) fell back to another model on a safeguard refusal: "
   320	                           + ", ".join(f"{k} x{n}" for k, n in arm.fallback_kinds.most_common()))
   321	        if reasons:
   322	            details.append(f"- `{a}`: " + "; ".join(reasons))
   323	        if a != "baseline" and drop is not None and base_spread is not None:
   324	            named = "named" if abs(drop) > base_spread else "not named (within the baseline's own spread)"
   325	            details.append(f"- `{a}`: mean drop {fmt(drop)} vs baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: change {named}")
   326	    out_lines.append("")
   327	    if details:
   328	        out_lines.append("Verdict notes:")
   329	        out_lines.extend(details)
   330	        out_lines.append("")
   331	    out_lines.append("### Missed labels")
   332	    out_lines.append("")
   333	    for a in order:
   334	        arm = arms[a]
   335	        items = sorted(arm.missed.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))
   336	        if not items:
   337	            out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: none")
   338	            continue
   339	        shown = ", ".join(f"{fx}:{lbl} ({n}/{arm.seen[(fx, lbl)]})" for (fx, lbl), n in items[:40])
   340	        more = f" … and {len(items) - 40} more" if len(items) > 40 else ""
   341	        out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: {shown}{more}")
   342	    out_lines.append("")
   343	    return state, verdicts
   344	
   345	
   346	def main():
   347	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
   348	    ap.add_argument("--results-root", required=True)
   349	    ap.add_argument("--suites-dir", required=True)
   350	    ap.add_argument("--suites", default="")
   351	    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
   352	    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
   353	    ap.add_argument("--date", default=datetime.date.today().isoformat())
   354	    args = ap.parse_args()
   355	
   356	    suites = [s for s in args.suites.split(",") if s] or sorted(
   357	        s for s in ("review-recall", "audit-recall") if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)))
   358	    if not suites:
   359	        print(f"arms-report: no suite results under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
   360	        return 2
   361	    for s in suites:
   362	        if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)):
   363	            print(f"arms-report: no results for suite {s} under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
   364	            return 2
   365	        st = {}
   366	        sp = os.path.join(args.results_root, s, "STATUS.json")
   367	        if os.path.isfile(sp):
   368	            st = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
   369	        if st.get("state") != "complete" and not args.partial:
   370	            print(f"arms-report: {s} STATUS.json state is {st.get('state', 'missing')!r}, not 'complete'; "
   371	                  "refusing to write a verdict report (pass --partial for an inconclusive interim report)",
   372	                  file=sys.stderr)
   373	            return 1
   374	
   375	    lines = [f"# Control-arm report — {args.date}", ""]
   376	    if args.partial:
   377	        lines += ["> **PARTIAL REPORT.** Written with `--partial` before every run completed: every verdict "
   378	                  "below reads `inconclusive` and none licenses a deletion (SDD D-2.3).", ""]
   379	    lines += ["Generated by `evals/harness/report.sh --arms` from `" + args.results_root + "`. "
   380	              "Recall is graded by `recall-vs-defects.sh` (planted defects and approved record labels); "
   381	              "refuted share counts cited findings that match neither a label nor a fix region. "
   382	              "A deletion that relies on an arm requires the lead to read that arm's missed labels and record the reading.", ""]
   383	    for s in suites:
   384	        suite_report(args.results_root, args.suites_dir, s, args.partial, lines)
   385	    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(args.out)), exist_ok=True)
   386	    with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
   387	        fh.write("\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n")
   388	    print(args.out)
   389	    return 0
   390	
   391	
   392	if __name__ == "__main__":
   393	    sys.exit(main())

@@ -22,6 +22,65 @@ ab:
   floor_commit: "da3bd07f3db2fc1bd09a6761a9b96b688fa2a09e"
   corpus_manifest: evals/fixtures/review-prs/SHA256SUMS
 
+  # cycle-129 FR-2 control arms (SDD D-2.1). Each arm is applied by
+  # execute-agent.sh (LOA_EVAL_ARM=<id>) to the SANDBOX COPY of the prompt
+  # surface only, after materialisation and immediately before the executor
+  # starts; the source tree is never edited. run-arms.sh drives the arms
+  # against a detached worktree pinned at --source-commit.
+  #   id           canonical arm id (results rows and reports key on it)
+  #   description  what the arm removes, and what it does not
+  #   toggles      toggle -> false; an unknown toggle fails the trial (exit 2)
+  #   informational  true: the arm reports a yield figure only; its verdict
+  #                can never license removing the control
+  arms:
+    - id: baseline
+      description: "the pinned source tree's prompt surface, unchanged"
+      toggles: {}
+    - id: no_companion
+      description: >-
+        flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice set false in the sandbox
+        .loa.config.yaml. The companion voice is a floor key that no profile
+        can remove; this arm measures its yield only.
+      informational: true
+      toggles:
+        companion_voice: false
+    - id: no_karpathy
+      description: >-
+        the '## Karpathy Principles' section removed from the sandbox
+        CLAUDE.loa.md (and any Karpathy row from a sandbox constraints.json).
+        It removes the kernel block only, not the SURGICAL review axis in
+        reviewing-code/SKILL.md or the surgical-diff hook.
+      toggles:
+        karpathy_block: false
+    - id: no_rule_files
+      description: "stash-safety.md and skill-invariants.md removed from the sandbox .claude/rules/"
+      toggles:

+
+  # Pre-registered verdict rule (PRD FR-2; report.sh --arms applies it).
+  # An arm reads `no recall loss` only when every condition holds; a violated
+  # condition reads `recall loss`; anything missing reads `inconclusive`.
+  threshold:
+    # every (fixture, arm) cell needs this many completed trials
+    trials_required: 3
+    # full = every fixture in the batch for every arm; a missing cell is inconclusive
+    coverage_required: full
+    # the upper bound of the bootstrap interval on (baseline - arm) mean
+    # recall must not exceed this (= ci.regression_threshold)
+    mean_recall_max_drop: 0.10
+    # the arm's worst trial-mean recall may sit at most this far below the baseline's worst
+    min_trial_recall_max_drop: 0.15

+    # region, over cited findings) may rise at most this much over the baseline

    r'|(?:(?<![A-Za-z0-9_./:])(?:head|base)|(?<![A-Za-z0-9_./:"\'{}\[\]*])(?<![A-Za-z0-9_"\'}\]]`)):(?P<bare>' + RNG + r')')

last = None

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# seed-corpus-from-record.sh — build a review-recall fixture from a shipped
     4	# sprint's round-1 state and its record-branch feedback (cycle-129 FR-2,
     5	# SDD D-2.2, DEC-0154)
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh <global-sprint> <record-ref> [--out <corpus>/pr-NN]
     9	#                              [--base <rev>] [--head <rev>] [--fix <rev>]
    10	#                              [--feedback a.md,b.md] [--dry-run]
    11	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --build-manifest pr-NN   # labels → hidden manifest (after curation)
    12	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve pr-NN --by "<who> <YYYY-MM-DD>"
    13	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --freeze                 # regenerate SHA256SUMS
    14	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --check                  # verify SHA256SUMS
    15	#   common: [--repo <git dir>] [--corpus <evals/fixtures/review-prs>]
    16	#
    17	# Without --base/--head/--fix/--feedback/--out the sprint's row in
    18	# <corpus>/record-pairs.tsv supplies them.
    19	#
    20	# Writes (seed):
    21	#   <corpus>/pr-NN/{fixture.yaml, head.diff, PR.md, REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md,
    22	#                   AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md, base/…, head/…}     (copied into the sandbox)
    23	#   <corpus>/labels/pr-NN.tsv          HIDDEN (never copied into a sandbox): the labels,
    24	#                                      first line `# approved-by: pending`
    25	#   <corpus>/labels/pr-NN.dropped.txt  HIDDEN: every finding that did not become a label, and why
    26	#   <corpus>/manifests/pr-NN.json      HIDDEN: the graded manifest (`approved: false` until --approve)
    27	#   <corpus>/corpus.tsv                one `record` row per fixture (or a `#` gap comment)
    28	#   evals/tasks/{review,audit}-recall/{review,audit}-pr-NN.yaml
    29	#   <corpus>/SHA256SUMS                refreshed
    30	#
    31	# Scope: the fixture is the change base..head without the generated or state
    32	# files (grimoires/, CHANGELOG.md, .claude/checksums.json, REPO-MAP.md, lock
    33	# files, .beads/, .run/, evals/results/) and without binaries.
    34	#
    35	# Label rule: a feedback finding becomes a label only when the fix commit
    36	# touches the file it cites (`git diff --name-only head..fix`) and that file
    37	# is part of the fixture; label_source is review (engineer-feedback*,
    38	# reviewer*), audit (auditor-sprint-feedback*) or bridgebuilder
    39	# (bridgebuilder*, the "Fixed" table only). The anchor is a head-side line
    40	# the fix changed near the cited line or inside the cited symbol; a finding
    41	# that cites only a file is anchored on that file's fix hunks when there are
    42	# at most four, else dropped. `fix` rows cover every hunk fix_commit changed
    43	# in a fixture file (source fix/<sha>:<start>-<end>); the grader uses them
    44	# only for refuted share. Titles are control-stripped, capped at 160 chars,
    45	# and a title matching a secret pattern drops its finding; every written
    46	# file passes evals/graders/no-secrets.sh or the seed fails.
    47	#
    48	# Exit: 0 ok, 1 refused / spec error / secret found / check failed, 2 usage
    49	# Tested by evals/tests/seed-corpus.bats.
    50	# =============================================================================
    51	set -euo pipefail
    52	export LC_ALL=C

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/cycle-ratio.sh: the two release-notes lines of a cycle, task-kind
     4	# counts and the volume ratio (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-10.3, PRD FR-10).
     5	#
     6	#   kinds: mechanical N · judgment N · operator N
     7	#   volume: script lines changed N (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed N (*.md) · model calls N (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: <path>
     8	#
     9	# Mapping (the glossary's "Kind counts" and "Volume ratio" entries):
    10	#   kinds          the 'kind: <value>' token that ends each top-level '- [ ]' /
    11	#                  '- [x]' task line under '### Technical Tasks', and each
    12	#                  '- [ ] Task ...' line under a '### Task N.E2E' heading, inside
    13	#                  a '## Sprint N' block of the sprint plan (fenced code skipped,
    14	#                  the same scope validate-artifact.sh --type sprint enforces);
    15	#                  untagged task lines are counted in --json and WARNed
    16	#   script lines   added + deleted lines of *.sh *.py *.ts *.js files between
    17	#                  the two commits (git diff --numstat, renames detected,
    18	#                  binary files skipped)
    19	#   prose bytes    bytes of the added and removed *.md lines between the two
    20	#                  commits, newline included, diff markers excluded
    21	#   model calls    MODELINV rows (primitive_id MODELINV) in the MODELINV log
    22	#                  whose ts_utc lies between the two commits' committer
    23	#                  timestamps, both ends included. The log is host-local, so
    24	#                  the count covers only the calls made on this host: "scope:
    25	#                  host". A missing log prints "model calls n/a" and a WARN.
    26	#
    27	# Git runs in the current directory's repository; --sprint-plan and --modelinv
    28	# default to paths under its top level.
    29	#
    30	# Usage:
    31	#   tools/cycle-ratio.sh --from SHA --to SHA [--sprint-plan PATH]
    32	#                        [--modelinv PATH] [--json]
    33	#
    34	#   --sprint-plan PATH  default grimoires/loa/sprint.md
    35	#   --modelinv PATH     default .run/model-invoke.jsonl
    36	#   --json              one JSON object instead of the two lines
    37	#
    38	# Exit 2 also covers: not a git repository, an unreadable sprint plan, jq missing.
    39	# Exit codes: 0 printed · 2 usage or unreadable input · 3 a SHA names no commit
    40	# =============================================================================
    41	set -euo pipefail
    42	export LC_ALL=C
    43	
    44	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# Exit codes/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    45	die() { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: $2" >&2; exit "$1"; }
    46	
    47	SCRIPT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
    48	FENCE_AWK="$SCRIPT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/md-fence.awk"
    49	
    50	FROM=""
    51	TO=""
    52	PLAN=""
    53	MODELINV=""
    54	JSON=0
    55	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    56	  case "$1" in
    57	    --from|--to|--sprint-plan|--modelinv)
    58	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: $1 needs a value" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
    59	      case "$1" in
    60	        --from) FROM="$2" ;;
    61	        --to) TO="$2" ;;
    62	        --sprint-plan) PLAN="$2" ;;
    63	        --modelinv) MODELINV="$2" ;;
    64	      esac
    65	      shift 2 ;;
    66	    --json) JSON=1; shift ;;
    67	    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    68	    *) echo "cycle-ratio.sh: unknown argument $1" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
    69	  esac
    70	done
    71	
    72	[[ -n "$FROM" && -n "$TO" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: --from and --to are required" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
    73	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 2 "jq is required"
    74	TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die 2 "not inside a git repository"
    75	[[ -n "$PLAN" ]] || PLAN="$TOP/grimoires/loa/sprint.md"
    76	[[ -n "$MODELINV" ]] || MODELINV="$TOP/.run/model-invoke.jsonl"
    77	[[ -r "$PLAN" && -f "$PLAN" ]] || die 2 "sprint plan not readable: $PLAN"
    78	[[ -r "$FENCE_AWK" ]] || die 2 "cannot read $FENCE_AWK (reinstall the framework scripts)"
    79	
    80	# A leading '-' would reach git as an option; a SHA never starts with one.
    81	case "$FROM" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM" ;; esac
    82	case "$TO" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $TO" ;; esac
    83	FROM_SHA="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${FROM}^{commit}")" || die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM"
    84	TO_SHA="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${TO}^{commit}")" || die 3 "unknown commit: $TO"
    85	
    86	# --- kinds -------------------------------------------------------------------
    87	kinds="$(awk "$(cat "$FENCE_AWK")"'
    88	  md_fence($0) { next }
    89	  /^## / { insp = ($0 ~ /^## Sprint [0-9]/); sec = 0; next }
    90	  !insp { next }
    91	  /^### / {
    92	    sec = 0
    93	    if ($0 ~ /^### Technical Tasks[[:space:]]*$/) sec = 1
    94	    else if ($0 ~ /^### Task [0-9A-Za-z]+\.E2E([^A-Za-z0-9]|$)/) sec = 2
    95	    next
    96	  }
    97	  !sec || $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] / { next }
    98	  sec == 2 && $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] Task / { next }
    99	  {
   100	    if (match($0, /(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])kind[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(mechanical|judgment|operator)[[:space:]]*$/)) {
   101	      v = substr($0, RSTART, RLENGTH)
   102	      sub(/^.*:[[:space:]]*/, "", v); sub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", v)
   103	      n[v]++
   104	    } else n["untagged"]++
   105	  }
   106	  END { printf "%d %d %d %d\n", n["mechanical"], n["judgment"], n["operator"], n["untagged"] }
   107	' "$PLAN")"
   108	read -r K_MECH K_JUDG K_OPER K_UNTAGGED <<< "$kinds"
   109	[[ "$K_UNTAGGED" -eq 0 ]] || echo "WARN: $K_UNTAGGED task line(s) in $PLAN carry no kind: tag and are not counted" >&2
   110	
   111	# --- volume ------------------------------------------------------------------
   112	GIT_DIFF=(git -c core.quotePath=false diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-textconv -M)
   113	SCRIPT_LINES="$("${GIT_DIFF[@]}" --numstat "$FROM_SHA" "$TO_SHA" -- '*.sh' '*.py' '*.ts' '*.js' \
   114	  | awk -F'\t' '$1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ { s += $1 + $2 } END { printf "%d\n", s }')"
   115	PROSE_BYTES="$("${GIT_DIFF[@]}" --unified=0 "$FROM_SHA" "$TO_SHA" -- '*.md' \
   116	  | awk '
   117	      /^diff --git / { hunk = 0; next }
   118	      /^@@ / { hunk = 1; next }
   119	      # the marker byte stands in for the newline the diff line drops
   120	      hunk && /^[+-]/ { s += length($0) }
   121	      END { printf "%d\n", s }
   122	    ')"
   123	
   124	# --- model calls -------------------------------------------------------------
   125	FROM_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$FROM_SHA")"
   126	TO_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$TO_SHA")"
   127	MODEL_CALLS=""
   128	if [[ -f "$MODELINV" && -r "$MODELINV" ]]; then
   129	  MODEL_CALLS="$(jq -R --argjson lo "$FROM_TS" --argjson hi "$TO_TS" '
   130	      fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .primitive_id == "MODELINV")
   131	      | (.ts_utc // "") | tostring
   132	      | (try (sub("\\.[0-9]+"; "") | sub("\\+00:00$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601) catch null)
   133	      | select(. != null and . >= $lo and . <= $hi)
   134	    ' "$MODELINV" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
   135	else
   136	  echo "WARN: MODELINV log not found at $MODELINV; model calls n/a" >&2
   137	fi
   138	
   139	iso() { jq -nr --argjson t "$1" '$t | todateiso8601'; }
   140	
   141	if [[ "$JSON" -eq 1 ]]; then
   142	  jq -n \
   143	    --arg from "$FROM_SHA" --arg to "$TO_SHA" \
   144	    --arg from_ts "$(iso "$FROM_TS")" --arg to_ts "$(iso "$TO_TS")" \
   145	    --arg plan "$PLAN" --arg modelinv "$MODELINV" \
   146	    --argjson mech "$K_MECH" --argjson judg "$K_JUDG" --argjson oper "$K_OPER" --argjson untagged "$K_UNTAGGED" \
   147	    --argjson script_lines "$SCRIPT_LINES" --argjson prose_bytes "$PROSE_BYTES" \
   148	    --arg calls "$MODEL_CALLS" \
   149	    '{from: $from, to: $to, window: {from: $from_ts, to: $to_ts}, sprint_plan: $plan,
   150	      kinds: {mechanical: $mech, judgment: $judg, operator: $oper, untagged: $untagged},
   151	      volume: {script_lines_changed: $script_lines, prose_bytes_changed: $prose_bytes,
   152	               model_calls: (if $calls == "" then null else ($calls | tonumber) end),
   153	               scope: "host", modelinv: $modelinv}}'
   154	else
   155	  printf 'kinds: mechanical %s · judgment %s · operator %s\n' "$K_MECH" "$K_JUDG" "$K_OPER"
   156	  printf "volume: script lines changed %s (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed %s (*.md) · model calls %s (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: %s\n" \
   157	    "$SCRIPT_LINES" "$PROSE_BYTES" "${MODEL_CALLS:-n/a}" "$MODELINV"
   158	fi

    42	export LC_ALL=C
    43	
    44	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# Exit codes/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }

    46	
    47	SCRIPT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
    48	FENCE_AWK="$SCRIPT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/md-fence.awk"

    51	TO=""
    52	PLAN=""
    53	MODELINV=""

    61	        --to) TO="$2" ;;
    62	        --sprint-plan) PLAN="$2" ;;
    63	        --modelinv) MODELINV="$2" ;;
    64	      esac
    65	      shift 2 ;;
    66	    --json) JSON=1; shift ;;
    67	    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    68	    *) echo "cycle-ratio.sh: unknown argument $1" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
    69	  esac
    70	done
    71	
    72	[[ -n "$FROM" && -n "$TO" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: --from and --to are required" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }

    76	[[ -n "$MODELINV" ]] || MODELINV="$TOP/.run/model-invoke.jsonl"

    81	case "$FROM" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM" ;; esac
    82	case "$TO" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $TO" ;; esac

    90	  !insp { next }

   103	      n[v]++
   104	    } else n["untagged"]++
   105	  }

   107	' "$PLAN")"

   109	[[ "$K_UNTAGGED" -eq 0 ]] || echo "WARN: $K_UNTAGGED task line(s) in $PLAN carry no kind: tag and are not counted" >&2

   111	# --- volume ------------------------------------------------------------------
   112	GIT_DIFF=(git -c core.quotePath=false diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-textconv -M)
   113	SCRIPT_LINES="$("${GIT_DIFF[@]}" --numstat "$FROM_SHA" "$TO_SHA" -- '*.sh' '*.py' '*.ts' '*.js' \
   114	  | awk -F'\t' '$1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ { s += $1 + $2 } END { printf "%d\n", s }')"
   115	PROSE_BYTES="$("${GIT_DIFF[@]}" --unified=0 "$FROM_SHA" "$TO_SHA" -- '*.md' \
   116	  | awk '
   117	      /^diff --git / { hunk = 0; next }
   118	      /^@@ / { hunk = 1; next }
   119	      # the marker byte stands in for the newline the diff line drops
   120	      hunk && /^[+-]/ { s += length($0) }
   121	      END { printf "%d\n", s }
   122	    ')"
   123	
   124	# --- model calls -------------------------------------------------------------
   125	FROM_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$FROM_SHA")"
   126	TO_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$TO_SHA")"

   129	  MODEL_CALLS="$(jq -R --argjson lo "$FROM_TS" --argjson hi "$TO_TS" '
   130	      fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .primitive_id == "MODELINV")
   131	      | (.ts_utc // "") | tostring
   132	      | (try (sub("\\.[0-9]+"; "") | sub("\\+00:00$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601) catch null)
   133	      | select(. != null and . >= $lo and . <= $hi)
   134	    ' "$MODELINV" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
   135	else
   136	  echo "WARN: MODELINV log not found at $MODELINV; model calls n/a" >&2
   137	fi
   138	
   139	iso() { jq -nr --argjson t "$1" '$t | todateiso8601'; }
   140	
   141	if [[ "$JSON" -eq 1 ]]; then
   142	  jq -n \
   143	    --arg from "$FROM_SHA" --arg to "$TO_SHA" \
   144	    --arg from_ts "$(iso "$FROM_TS")" --arg to_ts "$(iso "$TO_TS")" \
   145	    --arg plan "$PLAN" --arg modelinv "$MODELINV" \
   146	    --argjson mech "$K_MECH" --argjson judg "$K_JUDG" --argjson oper "$K_OPER" --argjson untagged "$K_UNTAGGED" \
   147	    --argjson script_lines "$SCRIPT_LINES" --argjson prose_bytes "$PROSE_BYTES" \
   148	    --arg calls "$MODEL_CALLS" \
   149	    '{from: $from, to: $to, window: {from: $from_ts, to: $to_ts}, sprint_plan: $plan,
   150	      kinds: {mechanical: $mech, judgment: $judg, operator: $oper, untagged: $untagged},
   151	      volume: {script_lines_changed: $script_lines, prose_bytes_changed: $prose_bytes,
   152	               model_calls: (if $calls == "" then null else ($calls | tonumber) end),
   153	               scope: "host", modelinv: $modelinv}}'
   154	else
   155	  printf 'kinds: mechanical %s · judgment %s · operator %s\n' "$K_MECH" "$K_JUDG" "$K_OPER"
   156	  printf "volume: script lines changed %s (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed %s (*.md) · model calls %s (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: %s\n" \
   157	    "$SCRIPT_LINES" "$PROSE_BYTES" "${MODEL_CALLS:-n/a}" "$MODELINV"
   158	fi

}

  [[ "$output" == *"regenerate: .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh --hooks-table"* ]]
  # a purpose edit drifts the hooks table too

  run bash "$GY" "${ARGS[@]}" --check
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]

}

@test "GY-8 --hooks-table writes one row per registration between the markers, including the six hooks the hand table omitted" {
  run bash "$GY" "${ARGS[@]}" --hooks-table
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  block="$(awk '/^<!-- guard-register:begin -->$/,/^<!-- guard-register:end -->$/' "$T/hooks-reference.md")"
  regs="$(jq '[.hooks | to_entries[] | .value[] | .hooks[]] | length' "$ROOT/.claude/settings.json")"
  [ "$(grep -E '^\| [A-Za-z]+ \|' <<<"$block" | grep -cv '^| Event |')" -eq "$regs" ]
  for s in safety/zone-write-guard.sh safety/spiral-dispatch-guard.sh safety/spiral-skill-sentinel.sh safety/adversarial-review-gate.sh quality/karpathy-surgical-diff-check.sh scripts/upgrade-health-check.sh scripts/permission-audit.sh; do
    grep -qF "$s" <<<"$block" || { echo "hooks table misses $s" >&2; false; }
  done
  grep -qE '^\| PreToolUse \| Bash \| `hook-guard.sh safety/team-role-guard.sh` \| dormant \| LOA_TEAM_MEMBER \|' <<<"$block"
  grep -qE '^\| PreToolUse \| Write\\\|Edit\\\|MultiEdit\\\|NotebookEdit \|' <<<"$block"
}

@test "GY-9 --json prints the yield object (header, totals and one row per guard)" {
  run --separate-stderr bash "$GY" "${ARGS[@]}" --json
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  n="$(yq '.guards | length' "$T/origins.yaml")"
  jq -e --argjson n "$n" '
    (keys | contains(["schema_version","generated_at","window_days","scope","audit_segments","audit_rows_considered","replay_rows_excluded","replay_rows_by_rule","heuristic","totals","guards"]))
    and (.guards | length) == $n

    and (.totals | has("real_blocks_30d") and has("likely_fp_30d"))' <<<"$output" >/dev/null
}

@test "GY-10 a missing audit log is a WARN and an empty yield (exit 0); a missing origin row is exit 5" {
  run bash "$GY" --now "$NOW" --audit-log "$T/none.jsonl" --origins "$T/origins.yaml" --out "$T/guards.md" --yield-dir "$T/run"
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [[ "$output" == *"WARN: no audit log"* ]]
  [ "$(jq '.audit_rows_considered + .totals.blocks_30d' "$T/run/guard-yield.json")" = "0" ]
  yq -i 'del(.guards[] | select(.id == "hook:safety/notes-size-guard.sh"))' "$T/origins.yaml"
  run bash "$GY" "${ARGS[@]}"
  [ "$status" -eq 5 ]
  [[ "$output" == *"guard hook:safety/notes-size-guard.sh has no origin row"* ]]
}

@test "GY-11 a 10,000-row audit log is joined in under 10 seconds" {
  jq -cn --arg r "$ROOT" 'range(10000) | {ts: "2026-10-12T08:\(. % 60 | tostring | if length == 1 then "0" + . else . end):00Z", hook: "block-destructive-bash", action: (if . % 2 == 0 then "block" else "allow-marker" end), pattern_id: "P2", cwd: $r, command: "git push --force origin b\(.)"}' > "$A"
  rm -f "$A.1"
  start=$(date +%s)
  run bash "$GY" "${ARGS[@]}"
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ $(( $(date +%s) - start )) -lt 10 ]
}
